We propose Internal Reasoning for Inference of Statement veracity (IRIS), an unsupervised hallucination detection method that inspects the uncertainty of the reasoning process. We assert that the model's confidence or uncertainty when verifying the truthfulness of a statement reveals the likelihood of hallucination.
